title: Canzoneri 2013 · Experiment 3, hand versus upper arm
citation: Canzoneri, E., Marzolla, M., Amoresano, A., Verni, G., & Serino, A. (2013). Amputation and prosthesis implantation shape body and peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 3, 2844.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.speaker_geometry: Keep them fixed relative to the upper arm.
published_method.response: Speeded vocal response to electrical touch. Compare site and perceived sound distance.

source_provenance.value: Pink-noise source class is specified. C.I.R.O. controlled presentation and response capture.
source_provenance.gap: Exact waveform, noise generator/seed, recording chain, and original assets unavailable.

trajectory_path.value: Same near-to-far speaker geometry referenced to upper arm, with far speaker 100 cm away. Both directions used with the two tactile sites.
trajectory_path.source: PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure; PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3; p. 6, Fig. 4

stimulus_speed.source: PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3; p. 6, Fig. 4
stimulus_speed.gap: No metric velocity specified for the amplitude-defined apparent movement.

gain_envelope.value: Exponential rising intensity for IN, falling intensity for OUT. Results describe symmetry between the waveforms.
gain_envelope.source: PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3; PDF p. 2, Experiment 2 Results
gain_envelope.gap: Exact gains, equations, per-speaker trajectories and calibrated SPL absent.

renderer_or_apparatus.source: PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3; p. 6, Fig. 4

condition_intermixing.value: Random combination of target timings and directions, randomly intermingled with catch trials.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Two blocks in each Upper Arm and Hand condition, with site order counterbalanced.
blocked_or_random_order.source: PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure

iti_jitter_policy.gap: Exact additional intertrial interval and jitter unspecified.

response_window.gap: Speeded vocal response is specified. Deadline, voice-key threshold and latency compensation are unspecified.

task_sequence_rules.value: Say TAH as quickly as possible to the tactile target, ignore the sound and withhold on auditory-only catches. Capture RT through a voice-activated relay.

value.intensity: level not independently quantified for Experiment 3

tactile_stimulus.source: PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure; PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3
tactile_stimulus.gap: Hand electrode coordinates and pulse settings unspecified.

soa_table.source: PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3; p. 6, Fig. 4

baseline_strategy.value: The Methods allocate all trials to tactile targets with sound and auditory-only catches. No tactile-only family in the reported design.

catch_trial_type.value: Sound only, no tactile target. Withhold response.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Eight repeats at five delays in both directions imply 80 target trials. The same sentence states 76.

block_count.source: PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure

total_trial_count.source: PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure; PDF p. 7, Methods, Experiments 2 and 3
total_trial_count.gap: Methods describe the conflicting target counts for a two-block task. Experiment 3 states two blocks per tactile site. Exact per-site and per-participant totals require the original trial files.

implementation_gaps: The reported target trial count conflicts with the stated factorial repetitions. The original trial files are needed for exact allocation per site.
A calibrated two-site electrocutaneous and vocal response scheduler must reproduce the physical apparatus.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.

design.name: Canzoneri 2013 · Experiment 3, hand versus upper arm

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/srep02844. PDF p. 4, Experiment 3 Results and procedure; PDF pp. 5–7, Figs. 3–4 and Methods.
